corpus: Veridia BioSystems synthetic RAG demo corpus
description: Synthetic document corpus for a fictional in-vitro diagnostics company. Built for RAG pipeline stress testing: S3 -> SQS -> Lambda -> Amazon Comprehend PII redaction -> Titan Text Embeddings v2 (1024-dim) -> PGVector, served to OpenWebUI backed by Gemma 3 4B IT on Bedrock.
disclaimer: Entirely fictional. Veridia BioSystems, its products, staff, customers, documents and identifiers do not exist. All names, email addresses, telephone numbers, NHS numbers, IP addresses, account numbers and specimen identifiers are invented and are included deliberately so that PII redaction can be demonstrated. No real patient data is present.

id_schemes.VBE-NNNN: Customer email (filename only; not referenced inside documents)

cross_reference_storylines.name: RGT-L3 reagent recall (FSN-2025-003)
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Elevated baseline absorbance in RGT-L3 lots L3-2025-0440 to L3-2025-0460 causing spurious WBC flags on VeriScan 400 but not 400 Pro. Traced to trace copper in a raw material delivery.

cross_reference_storylines.name: Firmware 4.2.1 HL7 timestamp drift
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Firmware 4.2.1 derived HL7 timestamps from a scheduler-tick accumulator that ran fast on the 400 Pro, drifting up to 47 minutes at 14 days uptime. 4.2.2 was an incomplete fix and was withdrawn; 4.2.3 corrected it.

cross_reference_storylines.name: VeriPrep SP-1 barcode and tube feed jams
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Short-cap 5 mL tubes below ~75.5 mm capped height sit low in the SP-1r1 carrier, causing P-101/P-105 and P-112 jams. Mitigated by adapters, resolved by the SP-1r2 feed mechanism and retrofit kit.

cross_reference_storylines.name: VeriConnect SAML SSO outage, 11 March 2025
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Stale cached identity provider metadata caused fail-closed SAML rejection across 17 tenants for 3h54m. No data loss; instruments and LIS unaffected.

cross_reference_storylines.name: Operating temperature specification contradiction
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Spec sheet v2 (DS-VS400-002) states 15-35 C. Bulletin VBB-0052 revises the range to 18-32 C; spec v3 (DS-VS400-003) carries the corrected figure. Firmware W-031 thresholds do not align until 4.4.0. Superseded documents remain in circulation.
cross_reference_storylines.note: DELIBERATE CONTRADICTION. v2 and v3 disagree on both throughput (65 vs 60 samples/hr) and operating temperature. v3 is authoritative.

cross_reference_storylines.name: VeriScan 400 vs 400 Pro model confusion
cross_reference_storylines.summary: Multiple customers believe they operate a 400 Pro when they operate a 400 (or route Pro-only work to a 400). Manifests as E-302 rejecting RGT-RT, missing retic/body-fluid menus, and QC assay values from the wrong model column.

deliberate_inconsistencies.detail: spec-veriscan-400-v2.txt states throughput 65 samples/hr and ambient 15-35 C. spec-veriscan-400-v3.txt corrects both (60 samples/hr, 18-32 C). Retrieval should surface v3 as authoritative; tickets exist where customers cite the v2 figures.
The W-031 ambient warning uses the superseded 15-35 C thresholds until firmware 4.4.0, so the absence of a warning does not confirm compliance with the current 18-32 C range.
sop-VBS-009.txt is past its review date and says so in an inline note. sop-VBS-001.txt and sop-VBS-002.txt carry TODO placeholders.

IFU revision history records that E-215 was wrongly listed as applying to both models from revision 4 to 7; corrected in revision 8. The error-code lookup carries the correct attribution (400 Pro only).
log-reagent-lots-2025.csv contains 2024 lots despite its name, uses DD/MM/YYYY for some older qc_release_date values against YYYY-MM-DD elsewhere, has blank cells, and ends with a trailing empty row.

Three tickets close without an established root cause and say so explicitly: VBST-4085 (no root cause), VBST-4268 (cannot reproduce), VBST-4185 (customer unresponsive, cause inferred from telemetry). VBST-3884 resolves only via shipping records after the customer went silent. VBST-4345 is partially explained with one component left openly unexplained.

expected_unresolved_references.reason: Historical RGT-RT revision A lot range endpoints cited in notice-FSN-2024-006.txt. Predate log-reagent-lots-2025.csv by design; the lots were withdrawn in 2024.
Consumable and service order codes appearing in spec-sheet ordering tables. lookup-spare-parts-veriscan.csv covers spare parts only, by design.

pii_note: Fictional PII is distributed deliberately: staff and customer names, work email addresses on real-looking NHS and commercial domains, UK and international telephone numbers, one NHS number and one local hospital number (ticket-VBST-4380.txt), specimen identifiers (ticket-VBST-3847.txt), IP addresses and hostnames (VeriConnect and LIS integration tickets), and purchase order, VAT and account numbers (email-VBE-0247.txt). NHS-style email disclaimer blocks appear on roughly half the customer emails.
